title: Work Decomposition & Context Engine
objective: Turn business/engineering objectives into bounded, dependency-aware, risk-scored work units with deterministic context routing and machine-enforced split/scope limits.
forbidden_scope: ENG-03 validation-tier implementation beyond interfaces required by ENG-02

tasks.description: Define the permanent Agent Work Unit schema and bounded execution contract.
Implement dependency DAG validation and cycle/missing-dependency rejection.
Enforce mandatory split rules for oversized or cross-boundary work.
Define and validate risk classes R0 through R3.
Implement context routing and bounded context budgets.
Harden active-work diff/scope validation around AWU contracts.
Qualify work decomposition with adversarial cold-start and oversize-work scenarios.

done_when: every implementable task can be represented as one bounded machine-readable AWU
dependency DAGs fail closed on cycles missing nodes and unauthorized predecessors
complexity scoring is deterministic and produces mandatory split decisions
risk class is explicit and machine-validated
context routing loads only task-relevant authorities within declared budgets
actual Git diffs are constrained to the active AWU scope
fresh agents reject oversized ambiguous or dependency-invalid work before implementation
